intro.text: A gifted listener and the sister of Eshonai, who helped unlock the stormform and resented that Eshonai was chosen to test it.
Venli, the only one of nine listeners whose soul was not replaced by a Fused, was given envoyform by Odium and serves as his chief propagandist.
Venli, a listener in envoyform who served Odium as a propagandist, has secretly sworn the First Ideal with her spren Timbre, becoming a Surgebinder.
Venli is a Willshaper who has escaped Urithiru and found the surviving listeners on the Shattered Plains, including her mother Jaxlim.

story.text: Venli meant to test the stormform she had found herself, and was furious when the Five chose Eshonai instead, out of fear of losing Venli if the form proved flawed. Jealous, she believed her sister distrusted her and was stealing her discovery. Once the form changed Eshonai and she moved to transform every listener, Venli thought her plans too aggressive, plotted to seize control, and proposed killing listeners who refused the form.

After the Everstorm came, Venli's spren led her to search for her missing sister. She was heartbroken to find Eshonai dead and stunned that the spren only wanted the Shardplate Eshonai had worn. Somehow the moment let her hear the old Rhythms again. As she stripped off the Plate, she saw a strange spren escape from beneath the body.

Venli and her once-mate Demid were among nine listeners chosen to receive new forms. In the Everstorm, Fused took the bodies of all the others, but Odium protected Venli and gave her envoyform instead. Realizing the others were effectively dead, she found the strange spren again and hid it from the Fused.
Ulim, the voidspren who had helped Venli discover stormform, often withheld the truth from her, lied about Odium's intentions, and mocked her grief over Eshonai.

Venli became Odium's chief propagandist in Kholinar and then Marat, telling singers a new version of the listeners' story in which they sacrificed themselves to free the parshmen. Kept apart from her people, she began talking to a strange little spren and admitted that summoning the old gods had been a terrible mistake and that she wished she could be like her sister.

In Marat, Dalinar Kholin drew Venli into one of his visions and tried to negotiate, but she refused any peace. When Odium broke into the vision, Dalinar sent her out just in time. She then boarded a ship bound for Thaylen City.

At the Battle of Thaylen Field, Venli mostly served as a translator and went with Odium to watch Dalinar's expected fall. When Dalinar instead opened a perpendicularity of Stormlight, she slipped back to the ships and swore the First Ideal, bonding the little spren, Timbre, and becoming a Surgebinder. Timbre trapped the voidspren in her gemheart, so Venli kept her red eyes and could pass among Odium's forces.
Staying on the Thaylen ships after the battle, Venli heard former parshmen say they did not know who their people were, and decided to tell them the true story of the listeners.

Venli came to serve the Fused Leshwi as her Voice, while quietly gathering a small group of singers who hoped to escape the war. When Leshwi apologized to Raboniel for opposing her plan to invade Urithiru, she offered Venli to serve as Raboniel's Voice, and Raboniel accepted.

Venli came with Raboniel's troops when they invaded Urithiru. During the seizure a human soldier attacked her and she killed him in panic, and she and Timbre attuned the Lost. Raboniel only told her to carry a knife from then on.

Venli had become a scholar after the listeners met humans, creating a written script for their language. A woman named Axindweth gave her a gemstone containing Ulim. Over five years Venli's team wrote down the listeners' songs and stories, discovering nimbleform; Venli adopted it and joined the listener leadership as its representative.

Learning Rlain was alive, Venli went to ask Raboniel for his freedom, but Mraize arrived with Lift in a cage as a gift for Raboniel. Shaken, Venli tried to swear the Second Ideal, to free those in bondage, but it was not accepted; she realized she could not truly swear it after seeing a child caged.
Finding that secretspren and chaosspren did not work in the tower, Venli realized she could practice her Willshaper powers without being detected, and did so in a hidden corner of Urithiru.

On the night of the treaty with the Alethi, the Herald Nale told Venli and Klade that King Gavilar meant to betray the listeners and directed them to buy Szeth, leading to Gavilar's killing. Afterward Venli worked with Ulim to find new forms, telling Eshonai she sought mediationform for peace while secretly trying to capture a stormspren for stormform.

Hearing Kaladin was loose in the tower, Venli got Leshwi to protect Lirin and Hesina from the Pursuer and brought Lirin to tend the unconscious Radiants. When Dabbid reported Kaladin would not wake, Venli used Cohesion to free Lift to heal him, hoping the Fused would blame a surviving Stoneward, and told the others she had a Shardblade.

As girls, Venli stayed home with their mother Jaxlim while Eshonai traveled, spending hours learning the listener songs from her. Venli and Demid became mates and stayed together even after changing into different forms.

Raboniel, knowing Venli reported to Leshwi, offered to save her the time. Venli admitted to Raboniel her shame at destroying her people and asked why there could not be peace; Raboniel gave her a writ and a map showing a listener settlement on the Shattered Plains. Found crying by Rlain, she told him everything she had done, and decided it was time to leave.

As humans defended the Radiants from the Pursuer's troops, Timbre urged Venli to reveal her bond to Leshwi. Leshwi was overjoyed that spren had forgiven the singers and joined the fight to protect the Radiants. Venli admitted to Rlain she had no Blade, and Kaladin, newly sworn to the Fourth Ideal, sent them through the Oathgate to the Shattered Plains.

Venli found the listener settlement, where Thude and her mother Jaxlim still lived. Despite suspicion and hostility, she was allowed to see Jaxlim, whose failing memory had once driven her search for forms of power. She had brought a Reacher spren to heal her, and as she sang Jaxlim's favorite Song of Mornings, her mother recognized her and Cultivation accepted Venli's Words.

Venli settled among the listeners with her mother, now bonded to a Reacher, and learned of their new peace with the chasmfiends. Thude's Song of the Chasmfiends made her suspect something on the Shattered Plains drew them there to pupate. After the chasmfiends sheltered the settlement from the last highstorm, the stones told her to seek Narak and Roshar's fallen fourth moon, and she set out with the Five, Leshwi and chasmfiends.

Venli helped Leshwi find a place among the listeners, free of Odium. Under Narak her group found Odium's Perpendicularity. When Fused came seeking the listeners' help in the Second Battle of Narak, Venli secretly met Sigzil and arranged a treaty in which Queen Jasnah granted the listeners the Shattered Plains. The listeners fought for Odium, but when the contest of champions began, Venli showed El the treaty and he withdrew Odium's forces.

After Odium became Retribution, his messenger came to Venli's group in Narak, and they learned to receive Warlight from the Everstorm. Using Stoneshaping, Venli opened a passage down to what was now Retribution's Perpendicularity, and reflected on the great duty her people now bore.

personality.text: Envoyform lets Venli speak and understand every language, script and signal on Roshar, human and singer alike. Stormform had made her far stronger and tougher and let her cast red lightning, while nimbleform made her agile, precise and keen-minded.

Venli tends toward fatalism and dislikes battle, feeling unskilled at fighting. She is highly ambitious, caring more for power and recognition than for her people, and can be manipulative and deceitful, growing angry when her goals or respect are threatened. She is jealous of her sister Eshonai's position.

Venli is a skilled scholar who created a writing system from scratch and discovered several forms. She thinks quickly on her feet and is a capable craftswoman, having built and decorated her family's home in Narak, but has little skill in combat.

Eshonai's death changes Venli. Over time she grasps the true cost of her actions, regrets them deeply, accepts responsibility for bringing the Everstorm, and begins to care about other singers, though she remains proud and refuses compromise with humans.

Venli is slender with a thin face and red-and-white marbled skin with small black patches, a rare three-colored pattern among listeners. Her waist-length hair is tied in three places, and her dark, glassy eyes look violet in the right light. Envoyform makes her extremely tall, taller even than Alethi humans.
